jobs.title: GIS Analyst
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Vernadero Group Inc. (Vernadero) is a Veteran\-Owned Small Business founded in 1999 to provide infrastructure and environmental program support to Federal agency projects and activities throughout the United States and its territories. Vernadero is seeking a GIS Analyst to provide geospatial support for the Army National Guard (ARNG).

The successful candidate will join a team of other highly skilled analysts and will be responsible for performing geodatabase maintenance, quality control, and tool development on Common Installation Picture (CIP) layers. Typical responsibilities extend to web\-GIS, including maintenance and development of various ArcGIS Enterprise items including dashboards, hosted feature services, and scripting using the ArcGIS API for Python. The candidate must have some experience with nearly the entire ArcGIS suite of software because the position also requires leading training sessions and providing ad\-hoc support to ARNG staff and State/Territory GIS teams. This is a full\-time, permanent position that allows for remote teleworking.

Candidates who reside in the Washington, D.C., metropolitan region and are willing to work at least one day a week at the Army National Guard’s Readiness Center (TARC) facility in Arlington, Virginia, will be given precedence. The position also requires a Tier 1 Department of Defense background check and the ability to obtain a government issued Common Access Card.

**General Qualifications**

Candidates should possess the following minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in geography, geospatial science, computer science, or related field
* Minimum of 4 years of professional geospatial and geodatabase experience
* Extensive experience with ESRI ArcGIS Pro and utilizing extensions including data reviewer, spatial analyst, and network analyst
* Experience with ArcGIS Enterprise and manipulating/creating various types of items including dashboards, hosted feature services, and experience builder applications
* Experience with scripting using both ArcGIS Arcade, the ArcGIS arcpy module, and the ArcGIS API for Python
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office software, to include Excel, PowerBI, PowerAutomate, SharePoint, and Forms
* Excellent written and oral communications skills including leading training sessions and public speaking on occasion
* Customer service\-oriented skills to help with training sessions for entry\-level GIS users on how to pre\-process geodatabase submissions and use published map templates
* Organizational skills and the ability to work in a complex environment
* U.S. citizenship and ability to intermittently travel nationwide
* Valid U.S. driver’s license

**Preferred Qualifications**

Preference will be given to candidates that possess:

* Graduate degree in geography, geospatial science, computer science, or related field
* GISP Certification
* Experience leading GIS and geospatial support training classes
* Knowledge of Microsoft Access databases and how to update and maintain them
* Experience with Army and ARNG geospatial databases, infrastructure, and real property data and terminology
* Demonstrated experience with Python scripting using any ESRI\-published module
* Experience with SDSFIE version 4\.0
* Experience with the Department of the Army databases and software packages
* Experience administering an ArcGIS Enterprise Portal and PostgreSQL database

**Responsibilities** 

Specific responsibilities for the GIS Analyst may include the following:

* Develop content and teach GIS workshops to ARNG stakeholders
* Generate maps and other content to support funding requests for military construction projects to Congress via the DD 1391 process
* Communicate directly with ARNG stakeholders in multiple states
* Work with a team of GIS Analyst in the development of Common Installation Picture (CIP) data layers, metadata, and SDSFIE migration of several terabytes of data
* Maintain ArcGIS Enterprise dashboards, that include complex data sources involving Arcade scripting.
* Continued maintenance on a suite of ArcGIS Toolbox features including models, and published geoprocessing tools (Python arcpy module)
* Track stakeholder requests using various Microsoft SharePoint Lists and Excel files.
* Geodatabase quality control and post\-processing of ARNG stakeholder\-submitted data. This involves both manual and automated QA/QC procedures.

Pay: $75,000\.00 \- $80,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: Remote

jobs.description:
Overview:
**Job Title: GIS Analyst****Location: Remote**

Mano Lani LLC is seeking a GIS Analyst to support geospatial data development, analysis, mapping, and quality control activities. This position will use GIS tools to create, maintain, analyze, and validate geospatial information supporting facilities, infrastructure, real property, and other business needs.

The ideal candidate has hands\-on GIS experience and is comfortable working with spatial data, geodatabases, maps, and data quality standards.
**Key Responsibilities**
* Create, edit, maintain, and analyze GIS datasets.
* Perform spatial analysis, geoprocessing, data conversion, and mapping.
* Maintain geodatabases, feature classes, attributes, and metadata.
* Perform quality checks and correct spatial or attribute data issues.
* Develop maps, reports, dashboards, and other geospatial products.
* Assist with GIS data migration, integration, and standardization.
* Document data sources, processes, and quality review results.
* Work with analysts, planners, technical staff, and client stakeholders to support project needs.


Requirements:
**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in GIS, Geography, Geospatial Science, Environmental Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Professional experience working with GIS data and applications.
* Experience with GIS editing, mapping, spatial analysis, and data quality review.


• Working knowledge of geodatabases, coordinate systems, projections, and metadata.• Experience using Esri ArcGIS applications.* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to meet applicable client access requirements.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise, or similar Esri technologies.
* Experience supporting facilities, infrastructure, real property, or asset management programs.
* Familiarity with GIS data standards and quality assurance practices.
* Experience with geoprocessing models, scripting, or workflow automation.
* Experience working in a government or large enterprise GIS environment.


**Benefits:**
Mano Lani LLC offers a comprehensive benefits package including a liberal vacation plan, a matching retirement program, and competitive salaries commensurate with skills and experience. For more information about our organization, please visit our web site at www.manolani.com.
**Physical Requirements:**
Work may involve sitting or standing for extended periods of time. Position may require typing and reading from a computer screen. Must have sufficient mobility, including but not limited to bending, reaching, and kneeling to complete daily duties in a timely and efficient manner. There is a possibility that due to parking availability and location of work, walking moderate to long distance may be required. Possible lifting up to 25 lbs.

Please note: Mano Lani LLC reserves the right to change or modify job duties and assignments at any time. The above job description is not all encompassing. Positions functions and qualifications may vary depending on business needs.

Mano Lani LLC is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against applicants based on race, color, creed, religion, medical condition, legally protected genetic information, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical condition), sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, age, disability, or Vietnam era, or other eligible veteran status or legally protected characteristics.
Posted Salary Range: USD $57,000\.00 \- USD $70,000\.00 /Yr. Posted Salary Range: USD $57,000\.00 \- USD $70,000\.00 /Yr.

jobs.title: Meteorologist and GIS Developer
jobs.description:
Overview:

Lynker is seeking a sharp Meteorologist and GIS Developer to support a long term contract with the Weather Prediction Center (WPC) and will have direct interaction with scientists within NOAA as well as partners outside of NOAA. This includes; NCEP centers, NWS weather forecast offices, NOAA research facilities, academia, and the NWS Science and Operations Officer community. In this capacity the incumbent will work with the above partners to develop new forecaster tools applied to operational and experimental forecasts. The work will also strive to build the capacity to enhance impact decision support services (IDSS), effectively building a Weather Ready Nation.


In addition, the incumbent will work to provide enhancements that build upon current forecaster tools as well as work to develop new services and forecaster tools. Promising work will be transitioned to operations. The incumbent will provide training materials on the enhanced forecaster products and tools.


Areas of particular need and interest to be addressed include developing forecaster tools for heavy precipitation associated with land\-falling tropical cyclones, warm\-season convection, winter storms, and atmospheric rivers. Additional areas of focus include the use of ensemble model output to aid forecaster generation of probabilistic products, as well as exploring future roles of weather forecasters.


The ideal Meteorologist and GIS Developer will currently be able to develop tools featuring mapped data. Assignments are typically received in terms of expected outcomes and incumbents are expected to act independently to develop required information, including selecting approach, and to provide sound analyses and recommendations. Assigned projects may include analysis, application development, or other areas specific to the assignment.


Responsibilities:
**Duties of the Meteorologist and GIS Developer will include the following:**  

* Collaborate with meteorologists at NCEP, NWS field offices, academia, and outside partners to develop forecast tools from short to medium range time frames.
* Use scientific and technical meteorological expertise to develop tools for determination of hazard information (rainfall, snowfall, temperatures).
* Develop web applications using modern industry languages and tools.
* Coordinate with NWS staff and external researchers to develop improved forecast tools.
* As appropriate, contribute to formal scientific publications, and/or attending off\-site conferences, symposia and hazardous\-weather\-related outreach events.
* Perform related duties as assigned.
* Collaborate to transition forecaster tools and web services developed at WPC and elsewhere within NOAA into operations at WPC and other NOAA offices.
* Develop training materials to transition new tools and techniques into operations.


Qualifications:
**The Ideal Meteorologist and GIS Developer will have the following:**  

* Advanced degree in meteorology, hydrology or related earth science fields (MS or above preferred)
* Experience with deterministic and ensemble prediction system data sets and their application to hazardous weather diagnosis and prediction.
* Knowledge of weather forecasting \- short to medium range
* Experience with GIS, GeoTiff, JSON, GeoJSON
* Knowledge of React, JavaScript, Zarr, Cloud Services, and Version Control Systems
* Experience with software development support in a team environment
* Experience with Python and shell scripting within a UNIX/Linux Environment.
* Ability to organize, plan, and complete projects
* Excellent written and oral communication skills for documentation and presentations

 **About Lynker**  

Lynker is a growing, employee owned business, specializing in professional, scientific and technical services. Our continually expanding team combines scientific expertise with mature, results\-driven processes and tools to achieve technically sound, cost effective solutions in hydrology/water sciences, geospatial analysis, information technology, resource management, conservation, and management and business process improvement.  

We focus on putting the right people in the right place to be effective. And having the right people is critical for success. Our streamlined organization enables and empowers our talented professionals to tackle our customers' scientific and technical priorities – creatively and effectively.  

Lynker offers a team\-oriented work environment, and the opportunity to work in a culture of exceptionally skilled professionals who embrace sound science and creative solutions. Lynker's benefits include the following:* Comprehensive healthcare for the employee at no monthly cost
* Healthcare benefit covers medical, prescription drug, dental, and vision
* Personal Time Off (PTO) Policy plus paid holidays
* Highly competitive compensation plan regularly calibrated against industry and location benchmarks
* 401(k) retirement plan with company\-matching
* Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) – we're all company owners!
* Flexible spending accounts
* Employee assistance program (EAP)
* Short\- and long\-term disability insurance
* Life and accident insurance
* Tuition assistance/Training/Workforce improvement reimbursement per year
* Spot bonuses for exceptional performance
* Annual Employee Recognition Awards with bonuses
* Employee Referral Program
* Free centralized, self\-directed Learning Management System to learn at your own pace
* Personalized career growth plans for every employee

**Lynker is an E\-Verify employer.** **Lynker is an equal opportunity employer and makes all employment decisions based on merit, qualifications, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other legally protected status under federal, state, or local laws**.
